# Fork: versions the CI test env is held to (UV_CONSTRAINT in test-lint.yml).
# Resolved as of the upstream fork point (strands-labs/robots, 2026-10-13), so
# CI grades the suite against the releases upstream last graded it against,
# not whatever PyPI has today (mujoco 3.17 and strands-agents 1.62 broke it).
# Regenerate (raise the date when moving the fork forward):
#   UV_EXCLUDE_NEWER=2026-10-14T00:00:00Z uv pip compile pyproject.toml \
#     --extra all --extra dev --python-version 3.12 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --no-header --no-annotate \
#     | grep -v '^device-connect-' > .github/constraints/test-env.txt
# device-connect-* stay out so the workflow's source pin can still redirect them.
